news.text: 7 February saw the Provisional IRA launch an audacious mortar attack against **10 Downing Street** during a full cabinet meeting discussing the Gulf War. Firing three homemade projectiles from the rear of a parked Ford Transit van on Whitehall, one shell exploded in the rear garden mere yards from Prime Minister **John Major**, shattering windows and leaving a crater without causing **serious injury**.
news.youtube: Downing Street mortar attack February 7 1991 BBC news

news.text: 14 February saw Scottish studio DMA Design and publisher Psygnosis release the legendary puzzle-platformer ***Lemmings*** for the Commodore Amiga. Programmed by David Jones and Mike Dailly, players assigned distinct tasks—such as digger, blocker, and basher—to marching green-haired rodents to guide them safely to exits, creating an immediate critical phenomenon and one of the finest **British video games** ever created.
news.youtube: Lemmings Amiga original 1991 intro and gameplay

news.text: 16 February saw animated television sensation Bart Simpson conquer the UK Singles Chart as ***Do the Bartman*** soared to number one for three consecutive weeks. Co-written and produced anonymously by pop superstar **Michael Jackson** alongside Bryan Loren, the infectious dance-rap track from *The Simpsons Sing the Blues* became an inescapable **cultural sensation** across British youth culture.
news.youtube: The Simpsons Do The Bartman official music video 1991

news.text: 24 February saw World Championship Wrestling stage ***WrestleWar 1991*** at the Arizona Veterans Memorial Coliseum in Phoenix. The pay-per-view was headlined by a celebrated **WarGames match**, wherein **The Four Horsemen** (Ric Flair, Barry Windham, Sid Vicious, and Larry Zbyszko) defeated Sting, Brian Pillman, and the Steiner Brothers inside the dual-ring steel cage.
news.youtube: WarGames WrestleWar 1991 Four Horsemen vs Sting team

news.text: 28 February saw US President George H.W. Bush declare a cessation of hostilities in the Persian Gulf, marking the **liberation of Kuwait** after a swift 100-hour allied ground offensive. Trapped Iraqi forces fleeing north along Highway 80 suffered catastrophic losses, forcing Saddam Hussein's military command to accept all United Nations resolutions and agree to a **permanent ceasefire**.
news.youtube: Liberation of Kuwait ceasefire declared February 28 1991 BBC

gaming.title: Lemmings
gaming.reviewQuote: An absolute stroke of programming genius. Lemmings is funny, maddeningly addictive, and utterly indispensable.
gaming.headline: Green Hair, Floaters, Bashers, and DMA Design's Puzzling Triumph
gaming.gameplay: Conceived in Dundee, Scotland by **DMA Design** and published in Psygnosis's lavish dark packaging, *Lemmings* became a worldwide sensation upon its Valentine's Day 1991 debut on the Amiga. Faced with lines of mindless, green-haired creatures marching blithely towards cliff edges and boiling lava, players assigned eight distinct skills—climbing, floating, blocking, building, bashing, mining, digging, and suicide-exploding—to carve paths toward safety before the **countdown timer** expired.
gaming.reception: Critics showered *Lemmings* with near-unprecedented praise. Publications celebrated its charming pixel animations, ingenious difficulty curve, and delightful renditions of traditional folk tunes and classical melodies arranged by Scott Johnston and Brian Johnston. Review scores routinely exceeded 95%, establishing DMA Design as a world-class British development studio.
gaming.impact: Selling millions of copies and ported to virtually every computer, console, and handheld system on earth, *Lemmings* established DMA Design (later **Rockstar North**, creators of *Grand Theft Auto*) as a titan of British software development.
